_note: Per-map light scale (all lights, sun and sky), from comparing the first bake's mean light with Quake 3's own lightmaps (2026-10-22): maps more than 0.85-1.65x the original are pulled to 1.3x (bounce light makes the remaster a little brighter by design). q3map clips bright panels at 255; Godot doesn't, so maps with 4000-10000 surface lights over-light.
